subject.title: [Feature] Configurable thinking/reasoning block format per channel

question: Should OpenClaw add a public reasoning display-format contract, and should precedence be channel/account-first, agent/global-first, or one scoped surface only?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the fix adds a public config/default surface that affects multiple visible reasoning paths and existing channel formatting assumptions.

options.title: Add Minimal Display-Format Contract
options.body: Preserve italic by default, support a small approved enum such as italic, code, spoiler, or blockquote, and document one precedence order across channel/account and agent defaults.

options.title: Limit To Telegram Presentation
options.body: Defer shared agent defaults and solve the readability concern only inside the Telegram plugin, possibly alongside the parse/text-mode direction tracked at https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/10944.

options.title: Keep Fixed Rendering For Now
options.body: Reject new config surface until a broader reasoning presentation design is sponsored, leaving users with /reasoning visibility controls only.

recommendation.title: Add Minimal Display-Format Contract
recommendation.body: Preserve italic by default, support a small approved enum such as italic, code, spoiler, or blockquote, and document one precedence order across channel/account and agent defaults.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest history on reasoning visibility and the prior product/API review context for this exact feature.
